page.layout: One page of text, single column; a bracketed diagram of conjugation forms below the running text; catchword "Wir" at the foot right; page number 131 at top right.

main_text.p: Io fària amato, Tu farefti, Ich, du wurde, würdest geliebet seyn. Ego amarer, tu amareris.
Colui faria amato, velfi ameria, velcolui ameriafi, er wurde geliebet seyn. ille amaretur.
Noi faremmo, voi farefte amati; Wir wurden, jhr wurdet geliebt seyn. Nos amaremur, Vos amaremini.
Coloro fariano amati, coloro fi amieran, & ameriano, & amerianfi, sie wurden geliebet seyn, Illi amarentur.
main_text.head: Prateritum Plusquamperfect.
main_text.p: Concio fia cosa che, Avenga che io farei & faria flato amato. Sintemahln daß ich wurd geliebt gewesen seyn. Cum ego amatus essem, vel fuissem.
Tu farefti flato amato, du wurdest geliebt gewesen seyn. Tu amatus esses, vel fuisses.
Colui sarebbe & fariaflato amato, er wurde geliebet gewesen seyn. Ille amatus esset, velfuisset.

page.notes: Diagram: a brace joins the four plural forms (Noi faremmo, Voi farefte, Coloro farebbono, & fariano) to "flati amati". Page number and catchword read from the scan; the bottom "Ia" is a signature mark, left out. Some words in the Italian forms are doubtful and may be misprinted.
